summary: Iteration 7 — Admin-only Team screen (/app/frontend/app/team.tsx) + admin gating on Settings. Both backend and frontend testing PASSED with 100% success. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_team_endpoints.py — GET /api/auth/users returns 200 for admin (with correct shape, no _id leak, seeded admin present) and 403 for editor/viewer, 401 for unauth; PATCH /api/auth/users/{user_id} returns 200 for admin (create->GET verification confirms role persisted), 400 for invalid role, 403 for editor/viewer, 401 for unauth, 404 for unknown user. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, tokens injected via localStorage['orthovault:session_token']): (1) Unauth /team -> redirects to /login PASS. (2) Editor /team -> redirects to /dashboard PASS. (3) Editor /settings shows NO open-team-btn PASS. (4) Admin /settings shows open-team-btn PASS. (5) Tapping open-team-btn navigates to /team PASS. (6) Team list rendered 5 team-user-<id> rows with correct data; admin's own row contains yellow 'YOU' chip PASS. (7) Self-demote guard: tapping role-editor on admin's own row shows 'You can't demote yourself while signed in.' error and NO PATCH fires PASS. (8) Changing ed2's role via role-viewer fires PATCH /api/auth/users/user_test_ed2 with 200, row pill updates to 'Viewer' locally, modal closes; restore back to editor also succeeds PASS. testID conventions respected (team-user-<id>, role-admin/editor/viewer, team-modal-close, open-team-btn, team-back-btn). Component uses useAuth() with Redirect and Modal (no Alert) as required.

issues: Bottom-sheet role picker modal renders below the viewport bottom on the 390x844 mobile web preview (role-editor Y-position outside viewport). Playwright's normal click() fails with 'Element is outside of the viewport'; dispatch_event('click') works. Real touch on a device would still function since the modal is anchored to the safe-area bottom, but web preview showed the sheet not fully scrolled into view when opened via keyboard focus. Low priority — functionality confirmed working via JS-dispatched click.

action_items: None blocking — the Team screen and admin gating work exactly as specified.

OPTIONAL: In the /team modal, consider wrapping the ScrollView-parent so the bottom sheet is fully within viewport at open; or set an explicit maxHeight so long lists on smaller viewports don't push role rows off-screen (currently only 3 role rows so unlikely to hit users on real devices).

OPTIONAL/CARRYOVER: RN web warning 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' emitted repeatedly on route change — comes from RN elevation/shadow style props somewhere in the app (not team.tsx). Non-blocking web-preview warning.
critical_code_review_comments: team.tsx (191 lines) — clean, well under the 700-line advisory. Uses Redirect (not imperative router.replace) so gating happens declaratively before any /users fetch, which correctly avoids leaking the admin endpoint call for non-admins.
team.tsx L45: `useEffect(() => { if (user?.role === 'admin') load(); }, [user, load])` — correctly guards the fetch to admin only, matching the backend 403 boundary.

team.tsx L51-56: self-demote guard triggers BEFORE the try/catch that would fire the PATCH — verified in browser that no /api/auth/users/{id} PATCH network request is made when admin taps role-editor on their own row.
team.tsx L61: Optimistic local state update after successful PATCH — correct. Uses functional setUsers to avoid stale closure.
settings.tsx L117-132: 'Manage Team' section is gated by `user?.role === 'admin'` — verified editor session has zero DOM elements matching [data-testid="open-team-btn"].

server.py L270-287: Both endpoints use Depends(require_admin) which returns 403 for non-admin and 401 for unauth — matches expected boundary. Role validation whitelist is exact-match ('admin'|'editor'|'viewer').
